output:
Thanks for the details — that matches a known issue: the stats page can be slow to open when there’s around a year of history. We’ve prepared a fix for this, specifically for the stats page taking too long to open with lots of data.

You’re on version 1.1.0, so no extra details needed from you right now. Please keep an eye out for the next app update.

— The Ritmo team
